The '''battle of Randa''' was a battle of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==The battle==
Sometime between the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] decimated the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Randa Rebel base|base]] on [[Randa/Legends|Randa]]. The Imperial operation was led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gaen Drommel]].<ref name="Despoilers3" />

==Aftermath==
As a reward for this success, Admiral Drommel would eventually be given command of the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Guardian (Executor-class)|''Guardian'']].<ref name="Despoilers3" />
